runtime/number_text#

The native layer under json, math/decimal, numbers/bigint, strings/parse: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under json, math/decimal, numbers/bigint, strings/parse: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Integer spellings of strings/parse::Number.int: an optional '-', then for radix 0 an optional 0b/0o/0x prefix (base 10 otherwise), then at least one digit 0-9a-zA-Z below the base. Any length; radix is 0 or 2..36. int_parse fails with invalid_input where int_parse_valid is false.

Public API#

native int_parse_valid#

native int_parse_valid(text is string, radix is int) is bool

Whether text is an integer in radix.

native int_parse#

native int_parse(text is string, radix is int) is int

The integer text writes in radix.

native float_parse_valid#

native float_parse_valid(text is string) is bool

Decimal float spellings of strings/parse::Number.float (#170): an optional '-', at least one digit, then '.' and at least one digit; no exponent and no '+'. float_parse rounds to the nearest float and fails with invalid_input where float_parse_valid is false.

native float_parse#

native float_parse(text is string) is float

The float text writes.
